stoic: I need work done. Don't waste my time.
hard: Heard you're quiet and quick. Prove it.
Let's be clear: you screw this up, we have a problem.
calm: Evening, doc. I'll keep it simple.
Thanks for seeing me this late.
aggressive: Hurry up. People are looking for me.
Make it fast and make it hurt less than the last guy.
chatty: Love the neon. Very... underground. Anyway, here's the thing.
My cousin swore by you, so here I am!
paranoid: Is this room clean? No cameras? Okay. Okay.
Nobody followed me. I checked twice.
tired: Long shift. Long year. Let's get this done.
My back hurts just walking down here.
smooth: Doc. Pleasure. I hear you're going places.
Let's call this an investment in each other.
nervous: I've never done this before. Is it going to hurt?
I saved up for months for this.

neural: My head link keeps dropping. I need a cleaner bridge.
Work needs me jacked in faster.
eyes: My eyes can't keep up anymore. I want chrome that can.
I need to see what's coming before it gets to me.
arms: I need an arm that won't quit on me.
My grip's going. Can't afford that in my line of work.
legs: My knees are shot. I need to move again.
I need to outrun people. Fast.
spine: My back's held together with spite. Fix it.
Need my implants to actually talk to each other.
dermal: I want something under my skin that stops a knife.
respiratory: The air down here is killing me. Literally.
I need to breathe where others can't.
internal: My insides are wrecked from stims. I need help.
I want an edge nobody can see.

0: I'm short on cash, but I'll pay what I can.
1: I can pay the going rate.
Cash up front, if you want.

symptoms: Sometimes I hear dial tones that aren't there.
My hands shake when the chrome warms up.
My implants argue with each other at night.
returning: Back again, doc. Last job held up great.
You did good work last time. I want more.
referral: {name} sent me. Said you're the real deal.
